UNIQUE INTERIOR APPOINTMENTS The Q70L Premium Select
Edition offers an elegant and inviting interior with high-quality
materials. An exclusive aluminum interior trim1 surrounds you with
YOUR distinction, while the luxurious Graphite or Stone semi-aniline leather-
appointed seating1 gives the cockpit a modern aesthetic appeal.
COMFORT AT EVERY SEAT Luxury has been infused into the rear
EXPECTATIONS cabin, featuring heated seats that provide warmth with a touch
of a button as well as a reading light to keep you company. You’ll
also enjoy the rear window sunshade1 and 12v power outlet
that adds to the details to make sure you’re always at your most
comfortable.
Fusing the characteristics of a performance vehicle
CRAFTING TRANQUILITY Active Noise Control ensures that the
with the exclusiveness of an extended sedan, the
cabin of the Q70L offers better solace from the outside world.
bold originality of Q70L embodies motivation.

undesirable low-frequency engine sounds and neutralizes them
with sound waves of the opposite phase. The result is a quieter
and more peaceful driving experience, which still preserves the
more invigorating sounds of engine performance.
